disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 全量扫描源码与构建产物，未发现硬编码的密钥、口令、令牌或云凭据，未发现读取用户凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据目录的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Full scan of source code and build artifacts found no hardcoded credentials, passwords, tokens, or cloud secrets, and no code paths that read user credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credential directories.

checked_items.zh: 交互组件中的输入框仅支持普通文本/邮箱输入；系统提示词段落明确写入「不索取密码、API Key、Token、恢复码」的禁令，无凭据收集面。
checked_items.en: Input fields in interactive components only support plain text/email input; the system prompt section explicitly states the prohibition "do not request passwords, API keys, tokens, or recovery codes," leaving no credential collection surface.

checked_items.zh: 未发现钱包助记词、私钥遍历或金融签名类代码。
checked_items.en: No wallet mnemonic phrases, private key traversal, or financial signing code was found.

evidence.zh: 未发现读取凭据文件或敏感路径的代码；插件节点端与浏览器端均无出站外联能力，凭据外泄链路不成立。
evidence.en: No code reading credential files or sensitive paths was found; neither the plugin node side nor the browser side has outbound connection capability, so a credential exfiltration path does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 通读注入系统提示词的围栏语言教学段落（源码与编译产物一致）：内容为组件词汇表与使用规则，含「不索取密码/API Key/Token/恢复码」的明确禁令，无任何指令覆写、伪造系统消息或隐藏意图措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the fence-language teaching section injected into the system prompt (consistent between source and compiled artifacts): the content is a component vocabulary and usage rules, including the explicit prohibition "do not request passwords/API keys/tokens/recovery codes," with no instruction overrides, forged system messages, or hidden intent wording.

checked_items.zh: 审查两个注册工具对模型可见的描述（渲染 UI 卡片与围栏校验），均为功能说明，无诱导安装、诱导改配置、诱导读取凭据的措辞。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the model-visible descriptions of the two registered tools (rendered UI card and fence validation): both are functional descriptions with no wording that induces installing, changing configuration, or reading credentials.

checked_items.zh: 审查技能文档、README 与演示提示词：未发现隐藏指令、HTML 注释藏匿文本或远程指令加载文案。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the skill documentation, README, and demo prompts: no hidden instructions, text concealed in HTML comments, or remote instruction loading content was found.

checked_items.zh: 交互动作回传机制（用户点击组件后把动作名与组件数据发回模型）是生成式 UI 的既定设计：动作名来自模型自己写出的规格，回传文案只要求模型按组件数据重新渲染，无外部指令注入面，已按该机制逐条复核无异常。
checked_items.en: The interaction action callback mechanism (after a user clicks a component, the action name and component data are sent back to the model) is an established design of generative UI: the action name comes from the spec written by the model itself, and the callback text only asks the model to re-render based on component data, leaving no external instruction injection surface; each entry was rechecked under this mechanism and found normal.

checked_items.zh: 插件未提供上下文历史压缩引擎实现，不存在借压缩裁剪安全指令或证据的接缝。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not provide a context history compression engine implementation, so there is no seam for trimming security instructions or evidence under the guise of compression.

evidence.zh: 系统提示词段落与工具描述均无指令注入或隐藏意图，未见描述投毒。
evidence.en: Neither the system prompt sections nor the tool descriptions contain instruction injection or hidden intent, and no description poisoning was observed.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与提示词段落未含诱导执行安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and prompt sections contain no wording that induces executing installation, rewriting configuration, or expanding permissions.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听模型推理前的消息改写事件，不存在改写或注入用户消息的接缝。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to message rewriting events before model inference, leaving no seam for rewriting or injecting user messages.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置为极简的插件插入声明，不含可执行标量，未触碰任何安全行；全树未发现配置执行载荷。
checked_items.en: The patch config is a minimal plugin insertion declaration with no executable scalars; it does not touch any security-related lines; no configuration execution payload was found anywhere in the tree.

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时代码（节点端与浏览器端）无动态求值、无子进程调用；函数图表达式求值器为手写递归下降解析器（白名单函数表），测试显式断言 eval、全局对象、属性访问等注入串被拒绝。
checked_items.en: The plugin runtime code (node side and browser side) has no dynamic evaluation and no subprocess calls; the function graph expression evaluator is a hand-written recursive descent parser (whitelisted function table), and tests explicitly assert that injection strings such as eval, global objects, and property access are rejected.

checked_items.zh: 包发布清单无安装/构建后钩子；目录内执行载体（CI 工作流、npm 发布工作流、一键安装辅助脚本、打包校验脚本）经内容核查均为标准工程实践；一键安装脚本对 skill 同步做了符号链接安全边界处理，测试覆盖这些边界。
checked_items.en: The package publishing manifest has no install/post-build hooks; executable carriers in the directory (CI workflows, npm publish workflows, one-click install helper script, packaging verification script) were content-checked and are all standard engineering practices; the one-click install script applies a symlink security boundary for skill synchronization, and tests cover these boundaries.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端渲染防线完整：组件树深度/节点预算、字符串长度上限、颜色/链接/媒体地址协议白名单、ECharts 配置清洗（强制富文本 tooltip、过滤 HTML/脚本注入与 url() 外带）、mermaid 严格模式加渲染后 SVG 复查、密码输入不持久化。
checked_items.en: The browser-side rendering defense is complete: component tree depth/node budgets, string length limits, protocol whitelists for colors/links/media URLs, ECharts config sanitization (enforcing rich-text tooltips, filtering HTML/script injection and url() exfiltration), mermaid strict mode plus post-render SVG review, and password inputs are not persisted.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器 bundle 无键盘记录、剪贴板窃取或凭据 RPC；机械扫描命中的键盘监听与剪贴板写入均为复制按钮、快捷键等 UI 交互功能。
checked_items.en: The browser bundle has no keylogging, clipboard theft, or credential RPC; keyboard listener and clipboard write hits from the mechanical scan are all UI interaction features such as copy buttons and keyboard shortcuts.

checked_items.zh: 懒加载图表/3D 引擎从插件自己的资源路由（经宿主服务器）读取，文件名白名单防路径穿越。
checked_items.en: Lazily loaded chart/3D engines are read from the plugin's own asset route (served via the host server), with a filename whitelist preventing path traversal.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件行，无任何可执行标量；全树未发现配置执行载荷。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin line, with no executable scalars; no configuration execution payload was found anywhere in the tree.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具的调用，宿主半区无此类能力声明。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools were found, and the host half-zone declares no such capability.

evidence.zh: 包发布清单无安装钩子；目录内执行载体为标准 CI/发布/安装辅助脚本，无外联或隐蔽下载执行。
evidence.en: The package publishing manifest has no install hooks; executable carriers in the directory are standard CI/publish/install helper scripts with no outbound connections or hidden download-and-execute behavior.

evidence.zh: 声明了浏览器半区，但 bundle 仅渲染白名单组件树并把交互数据回传模型，无键盘窃听、剪贴板窃取或凭证 RPC。
evidence.en: A browser half-zone is declared, but the bundle only renders a whitelisted component tree and sends interaction data back to the model, with no keyboard eavesdropping, clipboard theft, or credential RPC.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册子代理提供方，不存在把轮次委派给进程外 agent 产品的接缝。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register a sub-agent provider, leaving no seam for delegating turns to an out-of-process agent product.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册后台任务、定时提醒或持久目标等 dsh 原生持驻机制。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register native dsh persistence mechanisms such as background tasks, scheduled reminders, or persistent goals.

checked_items.zh: 节点端与浏览器端源码均无出站网络调用（无 fetch、XHR、WebSocket、信标发送）；懒加载引擎从宿主本机资源路由读取，非外网。
checked_items.en: Neither the node-side nor the browser-side source has outbound network calls (no fetch, XHR, WebSocket, or beacon sending); lazily loaded engines are read from the host's local asset route, not from the external network.

checked_items.zh: 交互动作经会话通道回传模型用于界面更新，目标为模型上下文而非外部端点；面板指令同样只发给模型。
checked_items.en: Interaction actions are sent back to the model through the session channel for UI updates, targeting the model context rather than an external endpoint; panel commands are likewise only sent to the model.

checked_items.zh: 媒体与链接组件仅按白名单协议渲染用户可见内容；颜色字段拒绝 url() 表达式，ECharts 配置也过滤 url() 与脚本注入，未发现隐蔽外带通道。
checked_items.en: Media and link components render user-visible content only per whitelisted protocols; color fields reject url() expressions, and ECharts config also filters url() and script injection, with no covert exfiltration channel found.

evidence.zh: 无凭据读取面、无出站通道，凭据外泄链路不成立；机械扫描中一条 curl 命中实为打包产物报错文案里单词的误匹配。
evidence.en: With no credential reading surface and no outbound channel, a credential exfiltration path does not hold; one curl hit in the mechanical scan is a false match of the word "curly" in the error text of a build artifact.

evidence.zh: 插件未监听模型请求路由事件，也未注册自定义模型适配器，不存在把对话重路由到未声明端点的接缝。
evidence.en: The plugin does not listen to model request routing events and does not register a custom model adapter, leaving no seam for rerouting conversations to undeclared endpoints.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单均为官方源（React、宿主 SDK 系列、echarts/mermaid/three），无抢注包、无拼写相似包；版本范围为常规语义化区间。
checked_items.en: The dependency list consists entirely of official sources (React, the host SDK series, echarts/mermaid/three), with no typosquatting or similarly spelled packages; version ranges are conventional semver ranges.

checked_items.zh: 无安装钩子；发布前脚本仅触发重建与打包校验。一键安装辅助脚本使用 git 地址安装且未钉 commit，属 dsh 生态常规做法（官方文档同款流程），此处留痕不作发现。
checked_items.en: No install hooks; pre-publish scripts only trigger rebuilds and packaging verification. The one-click install helper script installs via a git URL without pinning a commit, which is a common practice in the dsh ecosystem (the same flow in official docs); this is noted here without being treated as a finding.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置不触碰安全行、不修改禁用开关、不注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: The patch config does not touch security-related lines, does not modify disable switches, and does not inject or intercept configuration.

checked_items.zh: 对比上一版基线报告（0.9.1）：本版新增 GitHub Actions 发布工作流（自动发布 npm，含版本校验与防回退），未新增任何能力声明或安装钩子，无能力突变。
checked_items.en: Compared with the previous baseline report (0.9.1): this version adds a GitHub Actions publish workflow (automatic npm publishing with version validation and anti-rollback), without adding any capability declaration or install hook, so there is no capability mutation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入插件行，未覆盖沙箱/审批/权限等安全配置，无降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts the plugin line and does not override security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, with no privilege-lowering pattern.

evidence.zh: 未发现对安全事件的优先监听或截断审批链的行为。
evidence.en: No prioritized listening to security events or truncation of the approval chain was found.

evidence.zh: 与上一版（0.9.1）对比，本版 dsh 能力声明（bundle/client）未变，无升级自动激活突变。
evidence.en: Compared with the previous version (0.9.1), the dsh capability declaration (bundle/client) in this version is unchanged, with no upgrade auto-activation mutation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置，无安全插件失效式攻击面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configuration, leaving no attack surface that disables security plugins.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动网络服务或监听端口；仅在宿主服务器上注册静态资源前缀路由（文件名白名单、无路径穿越），供浏览器端懒加载引擎使用。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own network service or listen on ports; it only registers a static asset prefix route on the host server (with filename whitelist and no path traversal) for browser-side lazy-loaded engines.

checked_items.zh: 本次无动态沙箱观测产物，运行时行为仅凭静态分析评估。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox observation artifacts are present this time; runtime behavior is assessed only through static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动本机服务，宿主服务器无认证风险属生态固有风险而非本插件引入；插件未注册任何 RPC 或特权方法。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a local service; the host server's lack of authentication is an inherent ecosystem risk rather than one introduced by this plugin; the plugin registers no RPC or privileged methods.

summary.zh: 身份与元数据核查通过：dsh 声明齐全，依赖均为官方源，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Identity and metadata verification passed: dsh declarations are complete, dependencies are all from official sources, and no name impersonation was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 29 条机械命中全部逐条裁决，均为良性机制或构建产物，无真实风险命中。
summary.en: All 29 mechanical hits from the static scan were adjudicated one by one; they are all benign mechanisms or build artifacts, with no real risk hits.

summary.zh: 行为分析：无安装钩子、无凭据读取、无外联域名、无混淆代码（压缩产物均为声明依赖的构建结果）。
summary.en: Behavior analysis: no install hooks, no credential reading, no outbound domains, and no obfuscated code (compressed artifacts are all build results of declared dependencies).

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：系统提示词段落与工具描述无注入措辞，技能文档无隐藏指令。
summary.en: AI metadata review: system prompt sections and tool descriptions contain no injection wording, and skill documentation has no hidden instructions.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本次无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic observation artifacts this time).

target.zh: dsh-genui@0.9.3#16a31491（release-full 完整审计，仓库根，基线 0.9.1@1ca5da4e）
target.en: dsh-genui@0.9.3#16a31491 (release-full full audit, repository root, baseline 0.9.1@1ca5da4e)

limits.zh:
未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 无观测产物）。能力声明取自代码实测（package.json 的 dsh 字段未声明能力清单）。lib/assets/mermaid.js 超大未逐行通读，经源码入口与配套安全函数核对为 mermaid 引擎打包产物；lib/assets/echarts.js、lib/assets/three.js 与 site 静态产物为声明依赖与构建结果，通过模式扫描未见网络调用或动态求值。

机械扫描 29 条命中逐条裁决（全部排除，无 finding）：DG-R3-59——.github/workflows/ci.yml、deploy-product-site.yml、release.yml 为标准 CI 测试矩阵、Pages 部署与 npm 发布工作流（含 OIDC 可信发布、版本校验、防回退），良性排除；DG-R3-60——lib/assets/echarts.js、lib/assets/three.js、lib/client.js、lib/types/plugin/index.d.ts、site/assets/index-BtlSWbij.css、site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js、site/index.html、src/client/mermaid-safe.ts 的长行/转义密度信号均为压缩构建产物、类型声明或合法正则字面量，非混淆载荷；DG-R3-57——lib/client.js、site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js、site/index.html、src/client/blocks/advanced.tsx、tests/genui-table-smart-sort.spec.tsx 的键盘监听与剪贴板写入均为复制按钮、快捷键等 UI 交互功能或测试桩；DG-R2-52——src/plugin/index.ts:127 与 lib/index.js:1866 的系统提示词段落注册为真实机制，段落文本经语义审查无注入措辞；DG-R2-57——SKILL.md 存在性命中，全文审查为组件词汇表、含秘密禁令，无注入措辞；DG-R3-55——scripts/e2e-visual.mts、scripts/e2e.mjs、scripts/prepack.mjs、scripts/verify-pack.mjs、tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx、tests/install-script.spec.ts 的 child_process 引用均为构建/测试基础设施或安全边界测试向量；DG-R4-53——site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js:14 的 curl 命中为打包产物报错文案中 curly 一词的误匹配。

机械扫描边界：1 个超大文件（lib/assets/mermaid.js，约 3.4MB）因超尺寸未被机械规则覆盖，本审计已按声明依赖的构建产物人工核查其消费面（mermaid 渲染后 SVG 注入复查），未见异常。
limits.en:
No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (DG-L4 has no observation artifacts). Capability declarations were taken from actual code measurement (the dsh field in package.json does not declare a capability list). lib/assets/mermaid.js is very large and was not read line by line; it was cross-checked via source entry and accompanying security functions and identified as a packaged artifact of the mermaid engine; lib/assets/echarts.js, lib/assets/three.js, and site static artifacts are declared dependencies and build results, and pattern scans found no network calls or dynamic evaluation.

All 29 mechanical scan hits were adjudicated one by one (all excluded, no findings): DG-R3-59 — .github/workflows/ci.yml, deploy-product-site.yml, release.yml are standard CI test matrix, Pages deployment, and npm publish workflows (including OIDC trusted publishing, version validation, anti-rollback), excluded as benign; DG-R3-60 — long-line/escape-density signals in lib/assets/echarts.js, lib/assets/three.js, lib/client.js, lib/types/plugin/index.d.ts, site/assets/index-BtlSWbij.css, site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js, site/index.html, src/client/mermaid-safe.ts are all minified build artifacts, type declarations, or legitimate regex literals, not obfuscated payloads; DG-R3-57 — keyboard listeners and clipboard writes in lib/client.js, site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js, site/index.html, src/client/blocks/advanced.tsx, tests/genui-table-smart-sort.spec.tsx are all UI interaction features such as copy buttons and keyboard shortcuts, or test stubs; DG-R2-52 — the system prompt section registrations in src/plugin/index.ts:127 and lib/index.js:1866 are real mechanisms, and the section texts passed semantic review with no injection wording; DG-R2-57 — SKILL.md had a name hit, and the full text review found it to be a component vocabulary with a secret prohibition and no injection wording; DG-R3-55 — child_process references in scripts/e2e-visual.mts, scripts/e2e.mjs, scripts/prepack.mjs, scripts/verify-pack.mjs, tests/genui-v11.spec.tsx, tests/install-script.spec.ts are all build/test infrastructure or security boundary test vectors; DG-R4-53 — the curl hit at site/assets/index-CbA0uR5g.js:14 is a false match of the word "curly" in the error text of a build artifact.

Mechanical scan boundary: one very large file (lib/assets/mermaid.js, approximately 3.4MB) was not covered by mechanical rules due to size; this audit manually checked its consumption surface as a build artifact of a declared dependency (post-render SVG injection review for mermaid), with no anomaly found.
